verified_root_causes: The original approved Build 6 multilingual feature requires BUILD_6_PLATFORM_INTEGRATION.sql to be run in Supabase first.
There is no recovered evidence that the Build 6 SQL was successfully installed.
The browser depended on the database translation catalog for many Language & Accessibility labels.
On refresh, server bootstrap preferences could overwrite a newer locally selected Español value with stale English.
fixes: Bundles the approved Spanish launch translation catalog directly in build-6-platform.js.
Español now previews immediately when selected, before Save.
Choosing Español automatically enables interface translation.
Save records an explicit user language choice locally before network calls.
An explicit local Español choice outranks stale English returned by server bootstrap.
After authentication, Lellee best-effort syncs the explicit local language choice back to the account.
Final repair also honors the explicit language marker.
Includes the original approved Build 6 SQL for full account-level multilingual support.
installation_order: 1. In Supabase SQL Editor run RUN_FIRST_BUILD_6_LANGUAGE_BACKEND.sql and wait for Success.
2. Upload the seven website files to GitHub root and replace existing versions.
4. Test Language & Accessibility -> Español. The visible interface should change immediately; then Save; then refresh.
